$schema-note: Read by the dependency audit gate. Each entry carries an advisory the gate would otherwise fail on.

policy.key: `ghsa` is the GitHub advisory identifier (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx), never the numeric id the package manager's audit prints.
policy.expires: REQUIRED, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Past its date the entry stops covering the advisory and the gate fails, so the deferral is argued again or the dependency is bumped.
policy.removal: The gate also fails on an entry matching no advisory in the tree: delete it once the dependency is fixed.
policy.reason: Say why the advisory cannot be fixed now and what makes carrying it acceptable meanwhile, in terms someone can re-check.
